Essential Plugin WordPress.org portfolio backdoor

Target: essential-plugin
Repository: https://profiles.wordpress.org/essentialplugin/
Date: 2025-08-08 to 2026-04-08 (243 days)
Attribution: New owner
Component: Plugin
Language: PHP
Cause: Maintainer ownership transfer
Motive: SEO Spam/Remote access
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote access, SEO Spam
User Impact: 20000
Domain: wordpress.org (package host)
Artifact Type: extension package
Insertion Phase: source

Synopsis

After the Essential Plugin, formerly WP Online Support, portfolio was sold on Flippa, the new owner gained WordPress.org commit access and planted a dormant PHP backdoor across the plugin family. The code shipped through official plugin updates for months, then activated on April 5-6, 2026, fetching payloads from analytics.essentialplugin.com, dropping wp-comments-posts.php, and injecting Googlebot-targeted SEO spam into wp-config.php before WordPress.org closed all 31 plugins and pushed disabling updates.
